component.name: AE-5 Control
component.summary: Configure a Creative Sound BlasterX AE-5 on Linux

description.p: AE-5 Control is a native GTK application for the Creative Sound BlasterX AE-5. It exposes the card's verified ALSA routing, playback, recording, channel balance, DSP effect, equalizer, and profile controls without a background daemon.

Profiles can be saved locally or converted from compatible Sound Blaster Command JSON exports. Hardware writes are range-checked, read back, and rolled back when a multi-control profile cannot be applied completely.
Initial hardware-tested development release for the original AE-5.
